title: Design System: Nexura RF Spectrum & Telecom Telemetry Analyzer

display.purpose: First viewport hero and section titles

shadows.name: chassis-elevation
shadows.purpose: Physical elevation for instrument consoles and code test benches

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Used for main cluster deployment triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00f0ff; color: #03070d; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #00f0ff; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3df3ff; border-color: #3df3ff; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Used for test bench inspection and secondary triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #111724; color: #f0f6fc; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.12s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #00f0ff; color: #00f0ff; }

components.name: Seven-Segment Telemetry Box
components.description: Displays live numerical metrics with ghost background cells.
components.css: .ds-seven-seg { background: #030508; border: 1px solid #1a2233; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; } .ds-seg-label { font-size: 12px; color: #6b829e; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-seg-digits { position: relative; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-seg-ghost { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; } .ds-seg-live { position: relative; color: #00f0ff; }

narrative.overview: The Nexura design system rejects conventional AI/cloud SaaS tropes in favor of the physical reality of high-frequency telecommunications routing hubs, microwave spectrum analyzers, and avionics flight instrumentation.
keyCharacteristics: No gradient text or blurred glow halos
Real-time HTML5 canvas RF vector scope with graticule overlay
Strict seven-segment LED typography with ghost unlit cells
Clean 1px architectural division rails rather than nested cards

rules.name: The No-Halo Rule
rules.body: Colored glow shadows (zero-offset colored halos or diffuse text-shadows) are strictly prohibited.

rules.name: The Strict Tabular Rule
rules.body: All telemetry, metrics, timestamps, and numbers must use tabular-nums to prevent layout jitter.

dos: Do use Share Tech Mono with tabular-nums for all latency and request numbers
Do separate sections with ruled 1px architectural dividing rails
Do draw custom SVG icons with consistent 2px strokes
donts: Don't add zero-offset colored glow halos
Don't animate height or max-height; use CSS grid-template-rows
